correctness.rationale: The 28 explicit lines divide into disjoint \(4+12+12\) classes. Restricted quartics factor as quadratic squares, and 28 is the geometric upper count for any smooth plane quartic in odd characteristic. Both radicals are quadratic; Frobenius-fixed counts follow directly. The character-sum conic \(u^2+v^2=1\) gives exact all-q parameter frequencies, including the characteristic-three collision. Exact independent rational-line enumeration verified 204 smooth parameters in 13 fields including degree-two fields.

value.rationale: The arithmetic of all 28 bitangents (odd theta characteristics) is a fundamental finite enumerative invariant of a genus-three quartic. The theorem classifies its Frobenius action and rational count for every member of a natural symmetric pencil, gives exact proportions of \(4,16,28\) rational bitangents for every odd prime power, and establishes a uniform quadratic splitting bound. This goes beyond a special-curve anecdote or geometric orbit table.
